g.text: tap = h[D]; cond = LP(HP(tap)); h <- send*in + fb*cond. HP: p = exp(-2*pi*fLo/fs); LP: a = 1 - exp(-2*pi*fHi/fs); disabled stage = 1.
Reader here: integer only. Fractional readers (layer 2, PROPOSED) exist in the MATLAB kernel only.
History = Unit Delay + variable Delay (D-1): a single variable Delay closes an algebraic loop in Simulink.
